Chresten Gamborg Puggaard is a data manager and political scientist (cand. polit.) involved in Denmark's national healthcare quality monitoring systems. He is employed as a data manager at RKKP and the [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] [^src1] [^src2]. 

Puggaard is a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], the steering group responsible for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database [^src1]. His role on the steering group provides essential expertise in data structure, technical infrastructure, and the administrative management of clinical quality data. This work supports the broader national initiative to ensure uniform, evidence-based, and patient-centered quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, a common and potentially serious chronic heart condition. The steering group's composition, which includes Puggaard, reflects a multidisciplinary and cross-sectoral approach to analyzing critical clinical outcomes and treatment practices across the Danish healthcare system [^src2].
